builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: Fight in Bear Form to start, then Cat Form from level 20. You take hits well and can heal yourself between fights.
builds.gear: Strength, Agility and Stamina. Leather armor, and a staff or other two-handed weapon. A little Intellect helps your healing.

why.Ferocity: Maul, and later Claw and Rake, cost less Rage or Energy, so you can use them more.
why.Thick Hide: More armor in your animal forms, so you take less damage.
why.Feral Swiftness: You run faster in Cat Form (level 20), and you dodge more.
why.Savage Fury: Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul and Swipe hit harder, and it opens Lacerate.
why.Shredding Attacks: Shred costs less Energy, so your Cat Form attacks come faster.
why.Predatory Strikes: Your melee attacks hit harder in Cat Form and Bear Form.
why.Sharpened Claws: More critical strikes while in Bear Form or Cat Form.
why.Leader of the Pack: Your group gets more critical strikes while you are in an animal form.
why.Lacerate: A bleed attack that stacks on the enemy. Rend and Tear makes your hits stronger against it.
why.Natural Instinct: Your melee critical strikes hit harder.
why.Furor: Helps you start strong when you change into Bear Form or Cat Form.
why.Rend and Tear: Your melee attacks hit harder against bleeding enemies.
why.Primal Bite: A strong bite attack, and it makes the enemy pay more attention to you.
why.Heart of the Wild: More Intellect, more Stamina in Bear Form, more Strength in Cat Form.
why.Natural Shapeshifter: Changing form costs less Mana, so you can change often.
why.Reflection: Part of your Mana comes back while you cast, so healing costs less downtime.
why.Gift of Nature: Your healing spells heal a little more.
why.Improved Rejuvenation: Rejuvenation heals more, so you recover faster after a fight.
why.Swiftmend: An instant heal for anyone who has your Rejuvenation or Regrowth on them.

fight: Change into Bear Form, then use Maul and Growl to keep the enemy on you.
Moonfire from a distance starts a fight, then change into Bear Form as it arrives.
Shredding Attacks
Cat Form (level 20): Claw, or Shred from behind, builds points. Ferocious Bite (level 24) spends them.
Lacerate
In Bear Form use Lacerate again and again so the bleed grows.
After a fight, cast Rejuvenation on yourself (and Regrowth from level 12), then move on.
Swiftmend
Hurt badly? Swiftmend heals you at once if you have Rejuvenation or Regrowth on you.
Losing a fight? Change into Bear Form, and heal yourself with Rejuvenation.

builds.name: Dungeon healer
builds.suits: Keeps your group alive with healing spells that work over time. Wild Growth, late in the build, heals a whole party.
builds.gear: Intellect first, then Spirit and Stamina. Look for gear that adds healing, in cloth or leather, and a staff or a held item.

why.Nature's Focus: Your Nature spells are less likely to be slowed when you are hit.
why.Heart of the Wild: More Intellect, which means more Mana for healing.
why.Naturalist: Healing Touch casts faster, and it opens Nature's Swiftness.
why.Reflection: Part of your Mana comes back while you cast.
why.Gift of Nature: Your healing spells heal a little more.
why.Improved Rejuvenation: Rejuvenation heals more, and it opens Improved Regrowth.
why.Swiftmend: An instant heal for a friend who has your Rejuvenation or Regrowth on them.
why.Nature's Swiftness: Your next Nature spell is instant, so you can rescue someone fast.
why.Living Spirit: More Spirit, and it opens Wild Growth.
why.Subtlety: Your healing spells draw less attention from enemies.
why.Tranquil Spirit: Healing Touch and Tranquility cost less Mana.
why.Improved Regrowth: Regrowth critical heals happen more often.
why.Wild Growth: Heals your target and the party members near them over a short time.
why.Bloom: When Rejuvenation or Regrowth runs out, the friend gets a final heal.
why.Genesis: Your healing over time heals a little more.

fight: Put Rejuvenation on whoever is being hit. It heals them over time.
Use Healing Touch for a big heal. From level 12, Regrowth helps when someone is in trouble.
Cast Mark of the Wild on everyone before the first fight.
Swiftmend
Swiftmend heals at once when Rejuvenation or Regrowth is on that friend.
Nature's Swiftness
In an emergency, Nature's Swiftness makes your next heal instant.
Wild Growth
When the whole group is hurt, use Wild Growth on the one who is hit most.
Run low on Mana? Stop healing those who are fine and drink between fights.

builds.name: Dungeon tank
builds.suits: Fight in Bear Form and keep enemies on you while your group hits them. You take a lot of damage and have the armor for it.
builds.gear: Stamina and Armor first, then Strength and Agility. Leather armor, and a staff or other two-handed weapon.

why.Ferocity: Maul, and later Claw and Rake, cost less Rage or Energy.
why.Thick Hide: More Armor in your animal forms, so you take less damage.
why.Feral Instinct: Swipe, your attack that hits several enemies, does more damage.
why.Brutal Impact: Bash stuns for longer and is ready again sooner.
why.Savage Fury: Maul, Swipe and Claw hit harder, and it opens Lacerate.
why.Shredding Attacks: Lacerate costs less Rage, so you can use it more often.
why.Sharpened Claws: More critical strikes in Bear Form, and it opens Blood Frenzy.
why.Predatory Strikes: You hit harder with every attack in Bear Form.
why.Lacerate: A bleed that stacks on the enemy and draws a lot of its attention to you.
why.Blood Frenzy: Critical strikes give you extra Rage, so you can use your attacks more.
why.Leader of the Pack: Your group gets more critical strikes while you are in Bear Form.
why.Natural Instinct: Your melee critical strikes hit harder.
why.Furor: Changing into Bear Form can give you Rage to start a fight with.
why.Rend and Tear: Your attacks hit harder against bleeding enemies, such as ones with Lacerate.
why.Primal Bite: A strong bite attack, and it makes the enemy pay more attention to you.
why.Heart of the Wild: Much more Stamina in Bear Form, so you have more Health.
why.Reflection: Part of your Mana comes back while you cast, so you can heal yourself.

fight: Change into Bear Form. Start each fight with Growl, so the enemy attacks you.
Use Maul as your main attack, and Demoralizing Roar to make enemies hit softer.
Lacerate
Use Lacerate again and again on the main enemy. The bleed grows and keeps its attention on you.
Bash (level 14) stuns an enemy for a moment. Use it to stop a hard hit.
Several enemies? Swipe hits them all. At level 28, Challenging Roar makes all of them attack you.
Keep an eye on your Health. Rejuvenation on yourself between fights saves your healer.
